draft_en.subject: DIN-rail switches for your electrical and instrumentation panels
draft_en.body:
Buongiorno,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the Ethernet switches in your electrical and instrumentation panels: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, redundant DC input, CE/RoHS - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP L2 managed version (VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $82.2. Neutral packing, from single units.

One question: which configuration do your industrial projects use most - plain gigabit or PoE?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
